s0101.literal: On jiaxu day an edict ordered the elimination of redundant offices in Jiangnan.
s0101.idiomatic: On jiaxu day an edict ordered the elimination of redundant offices in Jiangnan.

s0102.literal: Jiangnan had originally had four provinces — Huai-dong, Hunan, Longxing, and Fujian; Longxing was merged into Fujian. Of its eleven pacification commissions, beyond the established quotas all others were abolished, and the old concurrent ranks attached to various officials were stripped away.
s0102.idiomatic: Jiangnan had originally had four provinces — Huai-dong, Hunan, Longxing, and Fujian; Longxing was merged into Fujian. Of its eleven pacification commissions, beyond the established quotas all others were abolished, and the old concurrent ranks attached to various officials were stripped away.

s0103.literal: The tea transport commission and farm colony commission were abolished, their affairs placed under the local pacification commissions.
s0103.idiomatic: The tea transport commission and farm colony commission were abolished, and their affairs were placed under the local pacification commissions.

s0104.literal: The grain transport commission was abolished, its affairs placed under the mobile Central Secretariat.
s0104.idiomatic: The grain transport commission was abolished, and its affairs were placed under the mobile Central Secretariat.

s0105.literal: General administrations on all routes were to establish offices by upper, middle, and lower grades according to verified household counts.
s0105.idiomatic: General administrations on all routes were to establish offices by upper, middle, and lower grades according to verified household counts.

s0106.literal: Former Song officials eligible for service were to be registered and employed by the Ministry of Personnel.
s0106.idiomatic: Former Song officials eligible for service were to be registered and employed by the Ministry of Personnel.

s0107.literal: Shitatalun and Tangudai, who had been abruptly promoted to the executive, and Mangudai, who held darughachi of Wuwei Army while also remotely supervising Huang Prefecture pacification commissioner — all were dismissed.
s0107.idiomatic: Shitatalun and Tangudai, who had been abruptly promoted to the executive, and Mangudai, who held darughachi of Wuwei Army while also remotely supervising Huang Prefecture pacification commissioner — all were dismissed.

s0108.literal: At the time Huai-xi pacification commissioner Angir had come to audience and said Jiangnan officials were excessively numerous; hence this order.
s0108.idiomatic: At the time Huai-xi pacification commissioner Angir had come to audience and said Jiangnan officials were excessively numerous; hence this order.

s0109.literal: The Emperor addressed Angir: "A chancellor who understands Heaven's Way, observes geography, and exhausts human affairs — only one who combines all three is fit for the office.
s0109.idiomatic: The Emperor addressed Angir: "A chancellor who understands Heaven's Way, observes geography, and exhausts human affairs — only one who combines all three is fit for the office.

s0110.literal: You may have merit, but the chancellorship is not something to be coveted.
s0110.idiomatic: You may have merit, but the chancellorship is not something to be coveted.

s0111.literal: Among the Muslims Ahmad has the talent to serve as chancellor; Ali is young but also keen; southerners such as Lü Wenhuan and Fan Wenhu who came over with their armies — perhaps they could be placed in chancellor posts.
s0111.idiomatic: Among the Muslims Ahmad has the talent to serve as chancellor; Ali is young but also keen; southerners such as Lü Wenhuan and Fan Wenhu who came over with their armies — perhaps they could be placed in chancellor posts.

s0112.literal: " He then turned to those beside him and said: "You can tell Yao Shu and the others: Jiangnan officials are far too numerous — this you all know, yet none of you has ever spoken of it; only Angir has told Me.
s0112.idiomatic: " He then turned to those beside him and said, "You can tell Yao Shu and the others: Jiangnan officials are far too numerous — this you all know, yet none of you has ever spoken of it; only Angir has told Me.

s0113.literal: " Attendant Liu Temur then said: "Zhang Ding, a subordinate of Ali Haiya, is now also associate administrator.
s0113.idiomatic: " Attendant Liu Temur then said, "Zhang Ding, a subordinate of Ali Haiya, is now also associate administrator.

s0115.literal: Thereupon Grand Councillor Haber and others were ordered to instruct the Central Secretariat, Privy Council, and Censorate: "Among the Hanlin Academy and various southern scholars now serving as chancellors and pacification commissioners, and darughachi of various routes bearing tiger tallies, there are many absurd appointments; discuss how to reduce and eliminate them.
s0115.idiomatic: Thereupon Grand Councillor Haber and others were ordered to instruct the Central Secretariat, Privy Council, and Censorate, "Among the Hanlin Academy and various southern scholars now serving as chancellors and pacification commissioners, and darughachi of various routes bearing tiger tallies, there are many absurd appointments; discuss how to reduce and eliminate them.

s0116.literal: In all great and small government affairs, carry out what accords with the people's hearts and desires, and abolish what they do not desire."
s0116.idiomatic: In all great and small government affairs, carry out what accords with the people's hearts and desires, and abolish what they do not desire."

s0117.literal: On yihai day an edict directed that all ministries, commissions, and bureaus reporting matters for imperial hearing must route them through the Daily Record.
s0117.idiomatic: On yihai day an edict directed that all ministries, commissions, and bureaus reporting matters for imperial hearing must route them through the Daily Record.

s0118.literal: On dingchou day the ancestral temple hall columns had rotted; Vice Minister of Rites Barmas was ordered to report to the Supreme Chamber, and they were then replaced.
s0118.idiomatic: On dingchou day the ancestral temple hall columns had rotted; Vice Minister of Rites Barmas was ordered to report to the Supreme Chamber, and they were then replaced.

s0119.literal: On wuyin day twenty Yao stockades of the Xiyan Stream in Quan Prefecture submitted.
s0119.idiomatic: On wuyin day twenty Yao stockades of the Xiyan Stream in Quan Prefecture submitted.

s0120.literal: On jimao day one thousand Mongol troops were sent with Jiangdong pacification commissioner Zhang Hongfan by sea route to suppress remaining Song forces.
s0120.idiomatic: On jimao day one thousand Mongol troops were sent with Jiangdong pacification commissioner Zhang Hongfan by sea route to suppress remaining Song forces.

s0121.literal: Associate Administrator Mongudai requested an edict to summon Song Prince Guang Zhao Bing and Zhang Shijie and others; the request was denied.
s0121.idiomatic: Associate Administrator Mongudai requested an edict to summon Song Prince Guang Zhao Bing and Zhang Shijie and others; the request was denied.

s0122.literal: On gengchen day Zhang Sanba, Zhang Yan, Ji Wenlong, and others of Chuzhou rebelled; the branch secretariat dispatched pacification commissioner Yizhili with troops to suppress them.
s0122.idiomatic: On gengchen day Zhang Sanba, Zhang Yan, Ji Wenlong, and others of Chuzhou rebelled; the branch secretariat dispatched pacification commissioner Yizhili with troops to suppress them.

s0123.literal: On xinsi day Dashidu registered stray property in Zhongxing and other routes.
s0123.idiomatic: On xinsi day Dashidu registered stray property in Zhongxing and other routes.

s0124.literal: King Chen Guangbing of Annam sent envoys bearing a memorial as tribute.
s0124.idiomatic: King Chen Guangbing of Annam sent envoys bearing a memorial as tribute.

s0125.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the renwu new moon, Hunan commissioner-in-chief Zhang Lieliang and chief prosecuting officer Liu Yinglong joined Zhou Long and He Shier in raising troops; the branch secretariat deployed troops to suppress them, captured Zhou Long and He Shier, and beheaded them.
s0125.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the renwu new moon, Hunan commissioner-in-chief Zhang Lieliang and chief prosecuting officer Liu Yinglong joined Zhou Long and He Shier in raising troops; the branch secretariat deployed troops to suppress them, captured Zhou Long and He Shier, and beheaded them.

s0126.literal: Lieliang and his entire household and remaining soldiers fled to the Wuluo Cave of Si Prefecture, were struck by government troops, and both men died fighting.
s0126.idiomatic: Lieliang and his entire household and remaining soldiers fled to the Wuluo Cave of Si Prefecture, were struck by government troops, and both men died fighting.

s0127.literal: On jiashen day paper currency in one thousand two hundred seventy-seven ingots was granted to needy troops under Prince Ai-yachi's Jiandu garrison.
s0127.idiomatic: On jiashen day 1,277 ingots of paper currency were granted to needy troops under Prince Ai-yachi's Jiandu garrison.

s0128.literal: The mobile Censorate added four investigating censor positions.
s0128.idiomatic: The mobile Censorate added four investigating censor positions.

s0129.literal: Jiangnan Hubei Route, Lingnan Guangxi Route, and Fujian Guangdong Route each added chief prosecuting and surveillance commissions.
s0129.idiomatic: Jiangnan Hubei Route, Lingnan Guangxi Route, and Fujian Guangdong Route each added chief prosecuting and surveillance commissions.

s0130.literal: On yiyou day among Jiangnan route general administrations, seven were changed to direct prefectures and one to a prefecture; two direct prefectures were changed to prefectures.
s0130.idiomatic: On yiyou day among Jiangnan route general administrations, seven were changed to direct prefectures and one to a prefecture; two direct prefectures were changed to prefectures.

s0131.literal: On bingxu day because Jiangnan affairs were numerous and branch secretariat officials included none versed in letters, which might harm administration, Cui Bin was separately ordered to the Yangzhou branch secretariat and Zhang Shouzhi to the Tanzhou branch secretariat.
s0131.idiomatic: On bingxu day, because Jiangnan affairs were numerous and branch secretariat officials included none versed in letters, which might harm administration, Cui Bin was separately ordered to the Yangzhou branch secretariat and Zhang Shouzhi to the Tanzhou branch secretariat.

s0132.literal: On dinghai day an edict directed that tiger tallies formerly cast in Uighur script should now be changed to the national script.
s0132.idiomatic: On dinghai day an edict directed that tiger tallies formerly cast in Uighur script should now be changed to the national script.

s0133.literal: On guisi day troops returning from garrison after Tachai's campaign in Kui, together with Yangzhou and Jiangxi river forces, were all placed under naval wanhu Zhang Rongshi to guard the river mouth.
s0133.idiomatic: On guisi day troops returning from garrison after Tachai's campaign in Kui, together with Yangzhou and Jiangxi river forces, were all placed under naval wanhu Zhang Rongshi to guard the river mouth.

s0134.literal: On bingshen day right associate Tachu, left associate Lü Shi'ao, and associate administrator Jia Juzhen were placed in charge of branch secretariat affairs at Ganzhou; Fujian, Jiangxi, and Guangdong were all placed under them.
s0134.idiomatic: On bingshen day right associate Tachu, left associate Lü Shi'ao, and associate administrator Jia Juzhen were placed in charge of branch secretariat affairs at Ganzhou; Fujian, Jiangxi, and Guangdong were all placed under them.

s0135.literal: On dingyou day thirty men of the Jiangxi army who had fought hard against Zhang Shijie were each granted fifty taels of silver.
s0135.idiomatic: On dingyou day thirty men of the Jiangxi army who had fought hard against Zhang Shijie were each granted fifty taels of silver.

s0136.literal: Jiangxi associate administrator Li Heng was made chief commander-in-chief to lead Mongol and Han troops against Guang.
s0136.idiomatic: Jiangxi associate administrator Li Heng was made chief commander-in-chief to lead Mongol and Han troops against Guang.

s0137.literal: The Yangzhou branch secretariat was ordered to detach three thousand troops for Li Heng.
s0137.idiomatic: The Yangzhou branch secretariat was ordered to detach three thousand troops for Li Heng.

s0138.literal: Two thousand Shangdu garrison troops were restored to civilian status.
s0138.idiomatic: Two thousand Shangdu garrison troops were restored to civilian status.

s0139.literal: On renyin day the consort prince seal of Goryeo King Wang Zhen was recast.
s0139.idiomatic: On renyin day the consort prince seal of Goryeo King Wang Zhen was recast.

s0140.literal: On bingwu day the Kaiyuan pacification commission was changed to a pacification commission, Taicang to the Imperial Granary, the Zicheng Storehouse to the Directorate of Imperial Use, and the hides bureau was absorbed into the general administration.
s0140.idiomatic: On bingwu day the Kaiyuan pacification commission was changed to a pacification commission, Taicang to the Imperial Granary, the Zicheng Storehouse to the Directorate of Imperial Use, and the hides bureau was absorbed into the general administration.

s0141.literal: Salaries and official fields for Jiangnan were fixed.
s0141.idiomatic: Salaries and official fields for Jiangnan were fixed.

s0142.literal: On wushen day locusts struck Pu Prefecture.
s0142.idiomatic: On wushen day locusts struck Pu Prefecture.

s0143.literal: On jiyou day envoys were forbidden to pass through Naling Post.
s0143.idiomatic: On jiyou day envoys were forbidden to pass through Naling Post.

s0144.literal: On xinhai day Jingzhao Prefecture was changed to Anxi Prefecture.
s0144.idiomatic: On xinhai day Jingzhao Prefecture was changed to Anxi Prefecture.

s0145.literal: An edict directed that Jiangnan, western Zhe, and other regions must not levy taxes unreasonably and disturb the people.
s0145.idiomatic: An edict directed that Jiangnan, western Zhe, and other regions must not levy taxes unreasonably and disturb the people.

s0146.literal: A temple to the Orthodox Unity Celestial Master of Han was built in the capital.
s0146.idiomatic: A temple to the Orthodox Unity Celestial Master of Han was built in the capital.

s0147.literal: Associate administrator Li Heng was made Mongol and Han army chief commander-in-chief; Mangudai was made Fujian Route pacification commissioner; Zhang Rongshi and Zhang Ding were both made Hubei Route pacification commissioners; and Yeshimishi was made campaign commissioner.
s0147.idiomatic: Associate administrator Li Heng was made Mongol and Han army chief commander-in-chief; Mangudai was made Fujian Route pacification commissioner; Zhang Rongshi and Zhang Ding were both made Hubei Route pacification commissioners; and Yeshimishi was made campaign commissioner.

s0148.literal: In the eighth month, on the renzi new moon, appointment patents received by former Song officials were recalled and destroyed.
s0148.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the renzi new moon, appointment patents received by former Song officials were recalled and destroyed.

s0149.literal: Because Jiading, Chongqing, and Kuifu had been pacified, Palace Guard troops were returned to their original bureau.
s0149.idiomatic: Because Jiading, Chongqing, and Kuifu had been pacified, Palace Guard troops were returned to their original bureau.

s0150.literal: Minister of Rites Chai Chun and others were sent as envoys to Annam with an edict sternly rebuking the king and ordering him to come to court.
s0150.idiomatic: Minister of Rites Chai Chun and others were sent as envoys to Annam with an edict sternly rebuking the king and ordering him to come to court.

s0151.literal: On dingsi day Liu Shen, mobile left deputy commander-in-chief of the coastal frontier commission, reported: "Fuzhou pacification commissioner Wang Ji'ang had already submitted but again plotted with Zhang Shijie.
s0151.idiomatic: On dingsi day Liu Shen, mobile left deputy commander-in-chief of the coastal frontier commission, reported, "Fuzhou pacification commissioner Wang Ji'ang had already submitted but again plotted with Zhang Shijie.

s0152.literal: " Ji'ang memorialized: "Our forces are weak; unless I temporarily go along, I fear disaster for the entire prefecture's people.
s0152.idiomatic: " Ji'ang memorialized, "Our forces are weak; unless I temporarily go along, I fear disaster for the entire prefecture's people.

s0154.literal: On renxu day an informer reported someone hiding Song gold; an edict ordered the matter not pursued.
s0154.idiomatic: On renxu day an informer reported someone hiding Song gold; an edict ordered the matter not pursued.

s0155.literal: Fifty thousand shi of grain was transported from the Two Huai to relieve Quanzhou military and civilians.
s0155.idiomatic: Fifty thousand shi of grain was transported from the Two Huai to relieve Quanzhou military and civilians.

s0156.literal: On yichou day Jinan chief administrator Zhang Hong, because he had once substituted for the people's tax payments, had borrowed five hundred fifty ingots of silver from Ali and Adachi and could not repay; an edict ordered collection suspended according to precedent.
s0156.idiomatic: On yichou day Jinan chief administrator Zhang Hong, because he had once substituted for the people's tax payments, had borrowed 550 ingots of silver from Ali and Adachi and could not repay; an edict ordered collection suspended according to precedent.

s0157.literal: On xinwei day the confiscated property of Zhangzhou pacification commissioner Shen Shilong was restored.
s0157.idiomatic: On xinwei day the confiscated property of Zhangzhou pacification commissioner Shen Shilong was restored.

s0158.literal: Shilong had formerly defended Jianning Prefecture; Guo Zan, having received Zhang Shijie's dispatch, tried to win Shilong over; Shilong seized Zan and beheaded him.
s0158.idiomatic: Shilong had formerly defended Jianning Prefecture; Guo Zan, having received Zhang Shijie's dispatch, tried to win Shilong over; Shilong seized Zan and beheaded him.

s0159.literal: Mongudai, because Shilong had executed someone on his own authority, registered his household property.
s0159.idiomatic: Mongudai, because Shilong had executed someone on his own authority, registered his household property.

s0160.literal: The Emperor said: "What crime did Shilong commit? Restore it to him.
s0160.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "What crime did Shilong commit? Restore it to him.

s0161.literal: " He was also appointed chief civilian administrator of the route.
s0161.idiomatic: " He was also appointed chief civilian administrator of the route.

s0162.literal: Central Secretariat officials said: "There was recently an order to recall the gold tiger tallies granted to civilian administrators on all routes; Jiangnan route officials should keep those granted them.
s0162.idiomatic: Central Secretariat officials said, "There was recently an order to recall the gold tiger tallies granted to civilian administrators on all routes; Jiangnan route officials should keep those granted them.

s0164.literal: By decree the Quanzhou sea goddess was titled Protector of the State, Bright Manifestation, Harmonious Rectitude, Good Blessings, Manifest Aid, and Heavenly Consort.
s0164.idiomatic: By decree the Quanzhou sea goddess was titled Protector of the State, Bright Manifestation, Harmonious Rectitude, Good Blessings, Manifest Aid, and Heavenly Consort.

s0165.literal: On jiaxu day the Anxi Prince's chancery reported: "With Chuan-Shu entirely pacified, there are eighty-three walled cities, stockaded towns, and caves; of these, thirty-three places such as Liyi City in Qu Prefecture should be garrisoned, and the rest altogether dismantled.
s0165.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the Anxi Prince's chancery reported, "With Chuan-Shu entirely pacified, there are eighty-three walled cities, stockaded towns, and caves; of these, thirty-three places such as Liyi City in Qu Prefecture should be garrisoned, and the rest altogether dismantled.

s0167.literal: On jimao day chief prosecuting and surveillance commissions were first established in Uighur territories.
s0167.idiomatic: On jimao day chief prosecuting and surveillance commissions were first established in Uighur territories.

s0168.literal: On gengchen day, because Sichuan was pacified, troops were rewarded with twenty-one thousand three hundred thirty-nine ingots of paper currency.
s0168.idiomatic: On gengchen day, because Sichuan was pacified, troops were rewarded with 21,339 ingots of paper currency.

s0169.literal: On xinsi day Luoci was promoted to Guangping Route Prefecture.
s0169.idiomatic: On xinsi day Luoci was promoted to Guangping Route Prefecture.

s0170.literal: Investigating censor Han Bing impeached associate administrator of the Dadu Route general administration Sherifudin for beating a subject to death; an edict ordered him beaten with the staff, removed from office, and two-tenths of his household property confiscated.
s0170.idiomatic: Investigating censor Han Bing impeached associate administrator of the Dadu Route general administration Sherifudin for beating a subject to death; an edict ordered him beaten with the staff, removed from office, and two-tenths of his household property confiscated.

s0171.literal: An edict to branch secretariat officials Sudu, Pu Shougeng, and others said: "The various foreign states on the southeastern islands all harbor sentiments of admiration for righteousness; through persons on tribute ships you may announce Our intent — if they can truly come to court, We shall honor them.
s0171.idiomatic: An edict to branch secretariat officials Sudu, Pu Shougeng, and others said, "The various foreign states on the southeastern islands all harbor sentiments of admiration for righteousness; through persons on tribute ships you may announce Our intent — if they can truly come to court, We shall honor them.

s0172.literal: In mutual trade coming and going, each may follow his wish."
s0172.idiomatic: In mutual trade coming and going, each may follow his wish."

s0173.literal: An edict instructed civilian administrators before the army and below the branch secretariat to pacify the people and see that they devote themselves to farming and their occupations; military and civilian officials were forbidden to seize civilian property or press good people into slavery.
s0173.idiomatic: An edict instructed civilian administrators before the army and below the branch secretariat to pacify the people and see that they devote themselves to farming and their occupations; military and civilian officials were forbidden to seize civilian property or press good people into slavery.

s0174.literal: Central Secretariat left associate Dong Wenbing was made privy council signatory; associate administrators Sudu and Pu Shougeng were both made left associates of the Central Secretariat.
s0174.idiomatic: Central Secretariat left associate Dong Wenbing was made privy council signatory; associate administrators Sudu and Pu Shougeng were both made left associates of the Central Secretariat.

s0175.literal: In the ninth month, on the renwu new moon, an edict directed that the two thousand two hundred soldiers Zhang Ziliang had mustered be made Palace Guard troops, with Zhang Heng and Chen Jin to command them.
s0175.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the renwu new moon, an edict directed that the 2,200 soldiers Zhang Ziliang had mustered be made Palace Guard troops, with Zhang Heng and Chen Jin to command them.

s0176.literal: On guiwei day the Eastern and Western Sichuan mobile privy councils were abolished; pacification commissions were established at Chengdu, Tongchuan, Chongqing, and Lizhou.
s0176.idiomatic: On guiwei day the Eastern and Western Sichuan mobile privy councils were abolished; pacification commissions were established at Chengdu, Tongchuan, Chongqing, and Lizhou.

s0177.literal: An edict directed sorting of troops registered on all routes: those verified as exhausted in strength were made civilians; those who relied on powerful families to evade service were restored as soldiers.
s0177.idiomatic: An edict directed sorting of troops registered on all routes: those verified as exhausted in strength were made civilians; those who relied on powerful families to evade service were restored as soldiers.

s0178.literal: Sorting officials dispatched and officials of the local prefectures and counties who could verify correctly without injustice were promoted one rank.
s0178.idiomatic: Sorting officials dispatched and officials of the local prefectures and counties who could verify correctly without injustice were promoted one rank.

s0179.literal: Half of the thirty thousand troops registered in the ninth year of Zhiyuan were reduced to civilians; merchant household surplus-male troops were all removed.
s0179.idiomatic: Half of the 30,000 troops registered in the ninth year of Zhiyuan were reduced to civilians; merchant household surplus-male troops were all removed.

s0180.literal: On wuzi day the Eastern Campaign Marshal's Headquarters was established at Tokyo.
s0180.idiomatic: On wuzi day the Eastern Campaign Marshal's Headquarters was established at Tokyo.

s0181.literal: On gengyin day Zhao Prefecture darughachi Li Hailasun reported that he wished to join Zhang Honglue in taking the two Song princes and requested Han and naval troops be assigned for him to command.
s0181.idiomatic: On gengyin day Zhao Prefecture darughachi Li Hailasun reported that he wished to join Zhang Honglue in taking the two Song princes and requested Han and naval troops be assigned for him to command.

s0182.literal: Central Secretariat left associate and Jiangdong Route pacification commissioner Lü Wenhuan was made right associate of the Central Secretariat.
s0182.idiomatic: Central Secretariat left associate and Jiangdong Route pacification commissioner Lü Wenhuan was made right associate of the Central Secretariat.

s0183.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on jiwei day, sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple; apart from the standing offerings, sheep, deer, pigs, and grape wine were added.
s0183.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jiwei day, sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple; apart from the standing offerings, sheep, deer, pigs, and grape wine were added.

s0184.literal: On gengshen day the imperial carriage arrived from Shangdu.
s0184.idiomatic: On gengshen day the imperial carriage arrived from Shangdu.

s0185.literal: On xinyou day paper currency in two thousand five hundred ingots was granted to relieve famine among the people of Bieshibali, Rihusi, and other places.
s0185.idiomatic: On xinyou day 2,500 ingots of paper currency were granted to relieve famine among the people of Bieshibali, Rihusi, and other places.

s0186.literal: Two thousand Han troops and one thousand new troops from Kuifu were assigned to Tachai to command.
s0186.idiomatic: Two thousand Han troops and one thousand new troops from Kuifu were assigned to Tachai to command.

s0187.literal: Two thousand bolts of cloth and silks as horse-price payment were granted to Qatagachi's troops; soldiers who had fought hard were rewarded in varying amounts.
s0187.idiomatic: Two thousand bolts of cloth and silks as horse-price payment were granted to Qatagachi's troops; soldiers who had fought hard were rewarded in varying amounts.

s0188.literal: On yichou day the Orthodox Unity temple was completed; an edict directed Zhang Liusun to reside there.
s0188.idiomatic: On yichou day the Orthodox Unity temple was completed; an edict directed Zhang Liusun to reside there.

s0189.literal: On dingmao day the prohibition on cutting firewood in mountain preserves was relaxed.
s0189.idiomatic: On dingmao day the prohibition on cutting firewood in mountain preserves was relaxed.

s0190.literal: On jisi day the branch secretariat was urged to build sea vessels and deliver them to Umar and Zhang Hongfan; four thousand additional troops were assigned for them to command.
s0190.idiomatic: On jisi day the branch secretariat was urged to build sea vessels and deliver them to Umar and Zhang Hongfan; four thousand additional troops were assigned for them to command.

s0191.literal: On gengwu day the Censorate was directed: wherever military officers privately employ soldiers, guilt shall be fixed according to the number.
s0191.idiomatic: On gengwu day the Censorate was directed: wherever military officers privately employ soldiers, guilt shall be fixed according to the number.

s0192.literal: An edict directed: "Records and documents of pacification commissions in Hexi, Western Capital, Southern Capital, Western Sichuan, Northern Capital, and other places should, following the recent Jiangnan precedent, be audited by the chief prosecuting and surveillance commission.
s0192.idiomatic: An edict directed, "Records and documents of pacification commissions in Hexi, Western Capital, Southern Capital, Western Sichuan, Northern Capital, and other places should, following the recent Jiangnan precedent, be audited by the chief prosecuting and surveillance commission.

s0193.literal: " The Henan and Hebei Route chief prosecuting and surveillance commission was moved to govern at the Southern Capital.
s0193.idiomatic: " The Henan and Hebei Route chief prosecuting and surveillance commission was moved to govern at the Southern Capital.

s0194.literal: Censorate officials reported: "Ala, brother of Shilibo, together with Wang Quanfu and others, captured and plundered good people; Shilibo allowed it and did not investigate.
s0194.idiomatic: Censorate officials reported, "Ala, brother of Shilibo, together with Wang Quanfu and others, captured and plundered good people; Shilibo allowed it and did not investigate.

s0195.literal: When an investigating censor's clerk was sent to question him, he would not confess.
s0195.idiomatic: When an investigating censor's clerk was sent to question him, he would not confess.

s0196.literal: " An edict ordered him seized and tried.
s0196.idiomatic: " An edict ordered him seized and tried.

s0197.literal: In the eleventh month, on the gengchen new moon, the Zaoyang wanhu headquarters reported: "Li Jun, in winning over Dafu Mountain stockade, was killed by Song commander Zhu.
s0197.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the gengchen new moon, the Zaoyang wanhu headquarters reported, "Li Jun, in winning over Dafu Mountain stockade, was killed by Song commander Zhu.

s0198.literal: " An order granted one thousand taels of silver to succor his family.
s0198.idiomatic: " An order granted one thousand taels of silver to succor his family.

s0199.literal: On dinghai day because Chen, Yuan, Jing, Zhenyuan, and other prefectures bordered Miao and Liao peoples and the people could not settle to their occupations, Tachai and Cheng Pengfei were both made Jingbei Hubei Route pacification commissioners; headquarters were established at Changde Route, remaining officials stayed at Jingnan Prefecture, and grain and military supplies were provided.
s0199.idiomatic: On dinghai day because Chen, Yuan, Jing, Zhenyuan, and other prefectures bordered Miao and Liao peoples and the people could not settle to their occupations, Tachai and Cheng Pengfei were both made Jingbei Hubei Route pacification commissioners; headquarters were established at Changde Route, remaining officials stayed at Jingnan Prefecture, and grain and military supplies were provided.

s0200.literal: On renchen day Jiangdong Route pacification commissioner Nangadai reported: "With Jiangnan now pacified, military and civilian affairs should each have their own officials; Mongol troops should be posted north and south of the Great River, with surplus males organized into units, to end the scourge of plunder.
s0200.idiomatic: On renchen day Jiangdong Route pacification commissioner Nangadai reported, "With Jiangnan now pacified, military and civilian affairs should each have their own officials; Mongol troops should be posted north and south of the Great River, with surplus males organized into units, to end the scourge of plunder.
